sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', c.date)::date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'HOUSEHOLD_2_488' AND s.store_id = 'TX_3' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('year', c.date)::date ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: Retrieves the total sales (y) for the specified product (HOUSEHOLD_2_488) at the specified store (TX_3), aggregated by year (ds), to forecast the trend over the next 3 years.
